Title: Koyarwar Blazor — Lily Design System

Description: Gina fom mai sauƙin isa kuma mai tsari da abubuwan Lily marasa kai na Blazor: abubuwan Razor masu sigogi da gwaje-gwajen bUnit.

# Koyarwar Blazor

Abubuwan ɗakin karatu na ajin Razor masu sigogi, `ChildContent` gutsattsarin zane, yaɗa sifofi da gwajin bUnit ɗaya ga kowane abu.

## Abin da za ka gina

Ƙaramin fom na tuntuɓa — fili mai lakabi, maɓallin aikawa, `@bind-Value` ɗaure, ainihin halayyar maɓallan rubutu da na'urar karanta allo — da farko ba tare da tsari ba, sannan da tsari, cikin kusan mintuna 10.

## Kafin ka fara

Kana buƙatar git da .NET SDK 11 ko sabo. Kowane aikin Blazor yana aiki — Blazor Web App, Server ko WebAssembly.

## Mataki na 1 — Ɗauki lambar

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-blazor-headless
dotnet build
dotnet test      # bUnit — 1,400+ cases across the catalog
```

Abubuwan suna cikin `src/LilyBlazorHeadless/Components/` — `Button.razor`, `TextInput.razor` — fayil ɗin Razor ɗaya kowanne. Yi nuni ga aikin (ko kwafi fayilolin) daga app ɗin Blazor ɗinka kuma ƙara `@using LilyBlazorHeadless.Components` zuwa `_Imports.razor`.

## Mataki na 2 — Abu na farko naka

```
<Button OnClick="Save">Save</Button>
```

Yana nuna `<button class="button">`. Ka'idojin sigogi na gamayya: `Label` ( `aria-label` don gyara), `CssClass` (ana ƙara shi zuwa ƙugiyar tushe), `ChildContent`da `[Parameter(CaptureUnmatchedValues = true)]` yaɗa sifofi domin kowane ƙarin sifar HTML ya wuce.

## Mataki na 3 — Haɗa ƙaramin fom

```
<Form OnSubmit="HandleSubmit">
  <Field Label="Full name" Required="true">
    <TextInput Id="name" Label="Full name" @bind-Value="name" Required="true" />
  </Field>
  <Button Type="submit">Save</Button>
</Form>

@code {
  private string name = "";
}
```

`Field` yana ɗaukar `Label` da ake gani a matsayin sigarsa maimakon abin lakabi da aka saka a ciki — ka ba shi sau ɗaya, a kan `Field`da `TextInput`mai dacewa na `Label` yana ba da suna mai sauƙin isa.

**An tabbatar a 2026-08-29:** wani daftarin da ya gabata ya saka wani abu `Label` daban a cikin `Field`, wanda ya nuna *lakabi* biyu (ɗaya fanko) saboda `Field` tuni yana nuna nasa daga shigarwar `Label` sigar — an gano ta hanyar duba lambar tushe ta abun; `Form` da kansa ba shi da sigar `Label` , don haka an gyara amfani da `<Form>` na daftarin da ya gabata ta barin sa, maimakon ƙirƙirar sifar da babu ita. [Hanyar fom ɗin tuntuɓa da aka haɗa](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/lily-design-system-blazor-web-examples/src/LilyBlazorWebExamples/Components/Pages/ContactForm.razor) tsari ɗaya ne, wanda aka gwada da ainihin gwaje-gwajen e2e da axe.

**Duba aikinka:** gudanar da app ɗin kuma fom ɗin yana kama da maras tsari — daidai kamar yadda aka nufa: tsarin yana nan gaba. Danna `Tab`: mayar da hankali yana ratsa kowane abin sarrafawa, ana sanar da lakabin, kuma aikawa yana aiki. An gama halayyar; kamannin naka ne kuma shi ne mataki na gaba.

## Mataki na 4 — Ba shi tsari

Ba ƙugiyoyin aji tsari — `.button`, `.text-input`, `.label`, `.field` — a cikin `app.css`, ko haɗa jigon da aka shirya a cikin `App.razor` / `index.html`:

```
<link rel="stylesheet" href="themes/wireframe.css" />
```

## Mataki na 5 — Kalli komai yana aiki

[App ɗin misali na Blazor Web](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/examples/) yana nuna cikakken kundin da tsari da nunawa, tare da gwaje-gwajen e2e na Playwright:

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-blazor-web-examples
dotnet run --project src/LilyBlazorWebExamples
```

## Matakai na gaba

- [Jigogi](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/tutorials/theming/) — sauyawa lokacin aiki da mai taimakon theme-picker na Blazor (ɗakin karatu na ajin Razor a NuGet).
- [Masu taimakon abubuwan so](https://lilydesignsystem.com/ha-001/tutorials/helpers/) — harshe da girman rubutu.
- [Kundin abubuwa](https://lilydesignsystem.com/components/) — siffofi, ARIA da maɓallan rubutu ga kowane abu.

Tambayoyi a hanya? [Shafin taimako](https://lilydesignsystem.com/help/#troubleshooting) cike yake da amsoshi — kuma idan wani mataki zai iya zama mafi bayyana, [gaya mana](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem) kuma za mu gyara koyarwar da farin ciki.
